{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# First, confirm: revenue contains commas?
assert df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).all(), "Revenue should contain commas"

# Remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now, filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check: are there any internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)?
internal_test_count = (df_completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum()

# If none, then we don't exclude any
if internal_test_count == 0:
    final_df = df_completed
else:
    final_df = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = final_df['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print results
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_completed)}")
print(f"Internal test orders in completed set: {internal_test_count}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (after excluding test orders if present): {total_revenue:,.2f}")"}
